Definition: Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Betser means "gold ore." The name is shared by several bearers: Son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher; A city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan. It turns up in Deuteronomy 4:43, Joshua 20:8 and Joshua 21:36.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Betser is a real place God named, part of the land He gave His people.
